title: apps/sub-route-reports: pass owner (team: insights) to validateApp

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0, breaking). Core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and reports (insights, found via grep, added as extra sub-task) pass owner from package.json team. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time, so one atomic PR was used instead of separate release steps; reports is not covered by CD change detection so it is not deployed by the pipeline.
